definitions.explanation: Lacking thoroughness or completeness in execution. Describes actions, measures, or attitudes that fall short of being fully carried out or properly implemented.

examples.japanese: ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不徹底|ふてってい}だ。
examples.english: The countermeasures are not thorough enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不徹底|ふてってい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だった。
examples.english: Inadequate management was the cause of the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{周知|しゅうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不徹底|ふてってい}なまま⟦{運用|うんよう}→運用：06811_unyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: Because operations started without thoroughly communicating the rules, confusion arose.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (not, un-) and ⟦{徹底|てってい}→徹底：01652_tettei⟧ (thoroughness, completeness). The opposite of ⟦{徹底|てってい}→徹底：01652_tettei⟧ (thorough). Often used critically to point out failures in implementation or follow-through.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不徹底|ふてってい}: inadequate countermeasures
- ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不徹底|ふてってい}: inadequate management
- {周知|しゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不徹底|ふてってい}: failure to properly inform
- {不徹底|ふてってい}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: halfhearted response

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中途半端|ちゅうとはんぱ}→中途半端：11305_chuutohanpa⟧: half-baked; half-finished — more colloquial, broader usage
- ⟦{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}→不十分：05616_fujuubun⟧: insufficient; inadequate — focuses on quantity rather than effort
- ⟦{徹底|てってい}→徹底：01652_tettei⟧: thorough; complete — the antonym

REGISTER:
Formal. Commonly used in news reports, official investigations, and business contexts when assigning blame or identifying problems.
